pictures.scene: Guercino, God the Father and Angel — the Father bending His head down over the globe of the earth, for He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary, the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
pictures.name: pd_guercino_neerzag

pictures.scene: Sebastiano del Piombo, The Descent of Christ into Limbo — Christ with the resurrection banner reaching His hand down to the captives, to hear a prisoner's groaning, to release those condemned to death
pictures.name: pd_piombo_gevangene

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Entry of Christ into Jerusalem — Christ on the donkey under the palms with the crowd going before Him, that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion, and praise Him in Jerusalem
pictures.name: pd_dyck_verkondigen

pictures.scene: Gentile Bellini, Procession in Piazza San Marco — a whole city assembled in procession before the great church, when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD
pictures.name: pd_bellini_koninkrijken

lines.text: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary;
the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
to release those condemned to death,
that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion
